description: Update a blog post (title, body, excerpt, tags, cover image, author, categories, featured, SEO).

body.description: Post body. Canonical is a Tiptap JSON doc ({type:"doc",content:[...]}); {markdown:"..."} or {html:"..."} are also accepted and converted to Tiptap on save.

category_ids.description: Category UUIDs to assign — list, not single. Use [] to clear.

confirm_token.description: Token from a prior dry_run call. Single-use, 7d TTL.

cover_image_url.description: Cover image URL. Field name MUST end with `_url` to persist.

dry_run.description: Preview the change without mutating and receive a confirm_token. When omitted, the change is applied immediately (legacy behaviour preserved).

featured_image_alt.description: Alt text for the cover image

is_featured.description: Mark as featured post (field name is `is_featured`, not `featured`)

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

published_at.description: Correct the publication date (ISO-8601; naive read as UTC). The supported way to re-date an imported or backfilled post so the blog index and feeds read in true order.

vayapin_pins.description: VayaPin pin ids that fit this article (e.g. ['BB:TAPAS','BB:CHAMPERS']) — auto-renders a card strip at the post bottom. Omit to leave unchanged; pass [] to clear. Resolve ids via GET /content/vayapin/cards.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_update_post
